name: CORAZA
recent: Coraza 近期在半导体设备需求带动下持续扩充产能，并有多位董事及主要官员行使 ESOS 期权或进行股份交易。公司截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度营收与净利均录得环比及同比增长。
notable: 董事经理及主要官员接受 LTIP 下的 ESOS 期权，涉及合共 200 万股期权。
因行使 ESOS 期权，公司发行 174,800 股新股，并于 2026 年 10 月 12 日上市。
执行主席 Lim Yook Yuen 于 2026 年 10 月 7 日以每股 RM1.46 出售 42,900 股。
risks: 主要官员 Chester Tang Chian Chiun 于 2026 年 10 月 5 日以每股 RM1.25 出售 50,000 股。
主要官员 Kor Han Chin 于 2026 年 9 月至 10 月期间分三笔共出售 150,400 股。
执行主席 Lim Yook Yuen 出售 42,900 股。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度，营收为 MYR 51,045,000，环比增长 15.7%，同比增长 20.1%；净利为 MYR 5,432,000，环比增长 25.1%，同比增长 69.8%；净利率为 10.6%，高于上一季度的 9.8%。

recent_en: Coraza has been expanding capacity amid semiconductor equipment demand, while several directors and principal officers have exercised ESOS options or traded shares. The company reported quarter-on-quarter and year-on-year growth in revenue and net profit for the quarter ended 30 June 2026.
notable_en: The Managing Director and principal officers accepted ESOS options under the LTIP, involving a total of 2 million options.
The company issued 174,800 new shares upon exercise of ESOS options, listed on 12 October 2026.
Executive Chairman Lim Yook Yuen disposed of 42,900 shares at RM1.46 per share on 7 October 2026.
risks_en: Principal Officer Chester Tang Chian Chiun disposed of 50,000 shares at RM1.25 per share on 5 October 2026.
Principal Officer Kor Han Chin disposed of a total of 150,400 shares in three tranches between September and October 2026.
Executive Chairman Lim Yook Yuen disposed of 42,900 shares.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 51,045,000, up 15.7% QoQ and 20.1% YoY; net profit was MYR 5,432,000, up 25.1% QoQ and 69.8% YoY; net margin was 10.6%, higher than 9.8% in the previous quarter.
